name: dev-skills
description: Language developer agents and generic development skills: rust-dev and cargo for Rust; refactor for behavior-preserving work in any language; tech-debt for a repo-wide structural audit; explain and walkthrough to render a change as a self-contained HTML page; prose-review to grade comments, commit messages, and PR descriptions. Pairs with spec-flow, which delegates to whichever developer agent a repo configures.
